newsitem.title: USA: NeoMedia Tech revises Q4, 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: NeoMedia Tech revises Q4, 1996 results.

text.p: NeoMedia Technologies Inc said that it has revised its fourth quarter 1996 results to reflect a loss of $1.2 million, or $0.24 a share from the $0.17 loss previously reported.
The company also revised its 1996 year loss to $0.72 a share from the $0.64 loss previously reported.
Last year, the company reported a loss of $0.07 a share in the fourth quarter and a loss of $0.26 a share for the full year.
The company said the adjusment reflects an accounting for the benefit of its operating loss carryforward for tax purposes.
